page.content:
Institution that held Michael from childhood to escape.

How Smith's Grove Sanitarium connects

  • Character: Michael Myers — Michael was held at Smith's Grove until the 1978 escape.
  • Character: Dr. Sam Loomis — Loomis watched Michael for years at Smith's Grove.

What is Smith's Grove Sanitarium?

Smith's Grove Sanitarium is where Michael is locked after killing Judith, and where Loomis watches him until the 1978 escape.

Key threads lead to Michael Myers and Dr. Sam Loomis.
